spec.assertion: buffApply stat chargeSpeedPct value 100 durationShots 3, targetSlug self; plus a counterfactual run with the buff stripped must yield FEWER 266.6% riders and less total damage. Fails under (a) a durationSec encoding (durationShots undefined), (b) treating charge speed as cosmetic/skipped (no shot-count delta), (c) an attackSpeedPct/fireRatePct substitution (wrong stat key).

buffApply stat chargeDamagePct value 58.5 durationShots 3 on self only; stripping it lowers vesti's total. Fails under chargeDamageMultPct (asserted absent — the undiluted BASE-charge scaler over-credits), under a seconds duration, and under an allies-scoped target.

Apply-rate is bounded: chargeDamagePct applies >= floor(rounds/3) and <= rounds+1. The engine has no self-status-negation gate, and because the window is exactly 3 rounds the gated and per-round encodings are damage-equivalent; the bound still kills a too-rare encoding (chargeCounter 3 with a mis-phased window, interval, or lastBullet).

spec.kitLine: reload to max: Removes Missile Guide
spec.assertion: buffRemove events with cause 'reload' for BOTH chargeSpeedPct and chargeDamagePct on vesti. The engine emits buffRemove only for removeOnReload buffs, so this is a direct structural read of S1b. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'durationShots:3 only, no removeOnReload' (zero buffRemove events) and under a burst/time-keyed removal.

One skill2-sourced damage event per landed full charge (>20 over 180s), zero when stripped, and teammate totals byte-identical across the strip. Fails under hitCount/interval/lastBullet trigger mis-keying (count decouples from rounds) and under any ally-visible side effect.

rangeApplied === false on every rider (the +30% full-range bonus is universally off on riders) and fbMajorApplied === true on the riders that land inside Full Burst (riders take FB by timing). Fails under a wrong noFb:true exemption or a rangeOk opt-in.

spec.kitLine: if self in Battle Formation: ATK 20%
spec.assertion: Asserts ABSENCE: no atkPct=20 self buffApply in the control run. No kit line grants Battle Formation and the schema has no self-status gate, so the conservative reading is inert; an ungated encoding would fire the 20% every round. A footage-confirmed always-on reading would flip this — that is the measurement gate. Paired it.skip documents the missing primitive.

spec.kitLine: if target in Explosive Round: PE 20%
spec.assertion: Two-part: (1) zero projectileExplosionPct applies in the control run (gate closed — no carrier inflicts Explosive Round); (2) NON-VACUITY — a patched run that deletes requiresTargetStatus from that block DOES emit the 20% buff, proving the block exists, is wired to a real per-round trigger, and is silenced by the status gate rather than absent, mode-gated, or dropped. Fails if the line was omitted entirely or gated by a different primitive.

buffApply trueDamagePct 60 on self only, durationShots undefined + expiresFrame defined (time-bounded, not round-bounded — a rounds encoding would roughly double the live window on her slow charge cycle); stripping it lowers only vesti's total. Fails under an allies-scoped target or a rounds duration.

One burst-slot damage event per trueDamagePct apply; stripping it lowers vesti's total with liter unchanged; fbMajorApplied === false and rangeApplied === false (burst-cast damage lands before the FB window opens). Fails under an FB-eligible or range-eligible encoding, and under a re-key to fullBurstEnter.

The first trueDamagePct buffApply must precede the first burst-slot damage event in the emission stream — i.e. the burst's own +60% True Damage is live for its own true-flavored nuke. Prose leaves the order implicit; this is the divergence most likely to be undocumented. Fails if the damage block is authored ahead of the buff block (a silent ~60%-of-492.3% shortfall on every cast).

Run on the fixed-B3 fixture (a competing Burst III): trueDamagePct applies === vesti's own burstCast count, and nuke count === that same number. Burst-cast and full-burst-enter are indistinguishable on a sole-B3 fixture, so this assertion needs the two-B3 comp; a fullBurstEnter mis-key over-credits every rotation the other B3 takes.

it.skip — no radius/AoE-geometry primitive, and the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so the line carries no damage payload. Belongs in `unmodeled`; encoding it as any stat buff would be an invented mechanic.

fixtures: PRIMARY: controlComp('vesti-tactical-upgrade', false) — liter B1 / crown B2 / vesti B3, fixed-B3 slot OFF. B1+B2 are required so a lone Burst III actually casts (a solo B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts). The fixed B3 is deliberately dropped for two independent reasons: she is a charge-damage buffer whose grants land in exactly the bucket every S1 assertion reads, and she is a second Burst III that would contest vesti's rotations and make burst-cast counts non-deterministic to reason about. SECONDARY: controlComp(SLUG, true) — the fixed B3 is re-enabled for ONE run, used solely for the burst-cast-vs-full-burst-enter trigger-identity assertion, which is provably non-discriminating on a sole-B3 comp. 8 hoisted full 180s runs total (base, dual, and six single-line counterfactuals built with withPatchedOverride: no chargeSpeedPct / no chargeDamagePct / no 266.6% rider / no 492.3% nuke / no trueDamagePct / Explosive-Round gate opened). Deterministic — no seed.
gaps: skill2 'if self is in Battle Formation status → ATK ▲20% for 3 sec' — it.skip: no self-status gate primitive exists (requiresTargetStatus is boss-scoped, requiresShielded is shields, `mode` is a user choice not a combat status), and no line in this kit grants Battle Formation. Modeled as inert; an active test asserts the 20% is NOT credited ungated. Enactment is measurement-gated (footage showing the status live from t=0 would flip it).

burst 'Explosion Radius ▲100% for 10 sec' — it.skip: no radius/AoE-geometry primitive; the scope-lock boss is a single partless target so the line has no damage payload. Belongs verbatim in the override's `unmodeled.burst`.

skill1 'while not in Missile Guide status' — the re-arm gate itself is not directly expressible; asserted only as an apply-rate bound (>= rounds/3, <= rounds+1). Because the window is exactly 3 rounds, the gated and ungated-per-round encodings are damage-equivalent on this unit, so the divergence is documentation-only.

Boilerplate risk flagged honestly: the event tap is attached both top-level (`onEvent`) and nested (`cfg.onEvent`) because the packet documents `cfg.onEvent` while `runComp` takes a single CompOptions; and the damage-event owner-slug channel is not part of the documented API, so `evSlug` probes slug/unitSlug/casterSlug/srcSlug and falls back to the unfiltered set (safe here — liter and crown emit no skill-sourced damage in this comp).

Rider magnitude (266.6%) and nuke magnitude (492.3%) are asserted by presence/count/direction, not by an absolute damage value: base ATK is class-derived and no labeled per-hit fixture was given in this packet, so an exact-value assertion would be a guessed constant rather than a derived one.
